rules: Official sources first; corroborate with a reputable secondary source where appropriate. A blocked source is recorded and skipped for the rest of the run; never retried in the same run. No Indian securities price data (announcements only for BSE and NSE).

australia.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
australia.use: CPI, labour force, wage price index, GDP/national accounts, household finance; release calendar

australia.name: Reserve Bank of Australia
australia.use: cash rate decisions, minutes, statistical tables, speeches, exchange rates

australia.name: Australian Treasury
australia.use: budget, tax, policy announcements, ministers' releases

australia.name: ASX
australia.use: company announcements, market notices (no price levels as centrepiece)

australia.name: ASIC
australia.use: consumer warnings, regulatory actions, MoneySmart education

india.name: Reserve Bank of India
india.use: policy rate, press releases, speeches (pages may bot-check; skip if blocked)

india.name: BSE and NSE
india.use: corporate announcements and notices only; no price or index data

united_states_and_global.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis
united_states_and_global.use: GDP estimates, PCE, trade; release schedule

united_states_and_global.name: OECD
united_states_and_global.use: Economic Outlook, CPI and employment data

knownAccessNotes.note: RBI speech PDF returned a bot check in the scheduled run; skipped, not retried. The interactive cloud session's network allowlist did not include bea.gov (page content was corroborated through the BEA search result instead); scheduled runs read bea.gov successfully on 28 Nov.
